text:
oliver: Heads-up — I'm seeing a sharp jump in conntrack entries in eu-central and the apiserver is logging a bunch of EPIPE/reconnect errors. Controller-manager is retrying object syncs, and GPU onboarding queue is growing.
maria: yep spotted the same in the cluster dashboard, connection count doubled in ~6m. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/shot/conntrack-euc1
sam: any recent kube-proxy or iptables changes deployed to that region?
oliver: not in the last 24h from what I can see. last infra churn was a Cilium upgrade 48h ago.
aj: Cilium's NAT/conntrack mode can miscount if conntrack helpers leak. logs show cilium-nat: conntrack dropped=...
chris: controller-manager pods in eu-central are Flapping: CrashLoopBackOff + spurious 429s from apiserver when conntrack saturates.
deploy-bot: [alert] EU-CENTRAL conntrack_high threshold breached (85%) — incident created: INC-2026-789
maria: quick check: current sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max = 262144. conntrack table usage at 230k.
aj: temp mitigation: bump nf_conntrack_max to 524288 on affected nodes: `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=524288`
            sam: we should also patch kube-proxy conntrack-min/timeout settings and roll cilium NAT fix.
oliver: agree — but patching kube-proxy cluster-wide will trigger rolling restarts and could worsen controller churn. propose a scoped rollout to eu-central only.
maria: action plan: 1) bump conntrack on eu-central worker nodes (hotfix), 2) rollback recent Cilium nat change if we see more leaks, 3) canary kube-proxy timeout tweak, 4) throttle GPU onboarding for 30m to drain queue.
aj: running `for n in $(kubectl get nodes -l region=euc1 -o name); do ssh $n sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=524288; done` — started now.
chris: apiserver errors reduced immediately after bump, controller-manager restart rate down from 8/m to 1/m.
sam: created rollout doc snippet for kube-proxy change and a canary on 3 nodes only: /docs/runbooks/kube-proxy-canary.md (internal).
oliver: keeping GPU onboarding paused for 20m. cost note: retries consumed ~18 GPU-hours in the spike — file for chargeback to infra-cost.
maria: filing post-mortem ticket SRE-4219 with timeline and cost estimate, will include heap of logs and conntrack dumps.
aj: follow-up: coordinate with platform team to schedule a Cilium NAT patch and validate with conntrack stress tests before global rollout.
chris: thanks all — monitoring for next 30m and then will unpause onboarding if stable. :thumbsup:
